description:
Return a browser page for uploading the user's own logo or photo.

Call when the user wants to add an image and this client cannot receive its bytes;
never ask for a local file path or claim images cannot be accepted.
Pass `design_id` for an existing design. Otherwise pass `order_id` for an order
already created in this session, before `design_generate_candidates`, and
`item_id` when that order has several items. On an
order with several items, an item whose design is already attached fails with
`DesignAttachedError`, because that design is final. An item whose uploaded file
has a submitted page mapping fails with `UploadMappingSubmittedError`.
Compass reuses a design for that order or creates an upload-only target;
a newly created target must not be used with `design_chat`.
The page attaches the image to the session for the next `design_chat` or
`design_generate_candidates` call.

Put the returned `url` in your reply as a markdown hyperlink (never the raw URL) and
tell the customer to open it and drop their image. When the upload card is displayed,
it shows an "Open upload page" button wired to the `url`, so just tell the customer to
open it and share the `url` again only if the customer asks for it.
name: design_get_image_upload_page

anyOf.description:
Canonical short-circuit response shape.

`status` is always `"error"` — acts as a discriminator for LLM consumers.
`error` is a machine-readable code (e.g. `session_not_found`).
`reason` is a human-readable explanation of why the call failed.
`detail` carries structured extra context (ids, available values, etc.).

title: Get the image upload page
